scope.scope: Actual model, native media, timestamp-delivered Danmuku and CSS web fullscreen. Bounded 20 rows/s after model readiness. No OS fullscreen, GPU completion or device coverage claim.

limitations: Only thirteen Danmuku/Mask files executed; not the full eighteen-package matrix or remote CI.
Two files are immutable historical-only baseline/load controls. Selected identities and capability-control assertions do not alone prove feature playback.
The Danmuku Worker is embedded in the selected UMD; Mask model resources remain independent local assets. The manifest inventories available bytes, not proof every asset was requested.
PiP/fullscreen availability, injected worker delays/CPU gaps, CSS mask boundaries, native model output and bounded pressure remain separate evidence categories.
Pressure runs use three bounded playback cycles and two rates, not long-run GPU, memory, acoustic or physical-device acceptance. Open package/environment/release gates are not waived.
Generic installed runtime/type consumers remain core/chapter only. Source proof is a targeted three-case check.
